name: Aspen Group
summary: Aspen Group is a stapled entity comprising Aspen Group Limited (the Company) and its controlled entities, and Aspen Property Trust and its controlled entities. Aspen was established for the purpose of facilitating a joint quotation of the Trust and the Company and their controlled entities on the ASX, with both entities being stapled together. The Deed of the Trust and the Constitution of the Company ensure that, for so long as the two entities remain jointly quoted, the number of units in the Trust and the number of shares in the Company shall be equal and that unitholders and shareholders be identical.
